sources.title: Mechanism of TrkB-mediated hippocampal long-term potentiation
sources.key_contribution: Y816/PLCγ path required for hippocampal LTP; Y490/Shc path dispensable
sources.used_for: core mechanism; Minichiello 2002 knockin experiment details

sources.title: TrkB modulates fear learning and amygdalar synaptic plasticity by specific docking sites
sources.key_contribution: Y816→acquisition (CaMKII), Y490→consolidation (Akt) dissociation in fear conditioning
sources.used_for: amygdala fear memory routing; acquisition vs consolidation distinction

sources.title: Hippocampal long-term potentiation is supported by presynaptic and postsynaptic tyrosine receptor kinase B-mediated phospholipase Cgamma signaling
sources.key_contribution: Both pre- and postsynaptic PLCγ required for full LTP; each alone insufficient

sources.title: TrkB signalling pathways in LTP and learning
sources.key_contribution: Comprehensive review of TrkB signaling in LTP and learning mechanisms
sources.used_for: background and framing of TrkB as LTP regulator

sources.title: Trk receptors: roles in neuronal signal transduction
sources.key_contribution: Comprehensive review of Trk family signaling: MAP kinase, PI3-kinase, PLCγ, and p75NTR interactions

sources.title: BDNF regulates the maturation of inhibition and the critical period of plasticity in mouse visual cortex
sources.key_contribution: BDNF overexpression → accelerated GABAergic maturation → precocious critical period closure
sources.used_for: critical period section; BDNF-TrkB→PV maturation mechanism

sources.title: Brain-derived neurotrophic factor overexpression induces precocious critical period in mouse visual cortex
sources.key_contribution: BDNF overexpression → precocious critical period start (earlier MD sensitivity), not blocking plasticity
sources.used_for: critical period section; BDNF as accelerator of critical period onset

sources.title: Truncated TrkB: Beyond a dominant negative receptor
sources.key_contribution: TrkB-T1 functions beyond dominant negative: BDNF sequestration, RhoGDI1/Rho GTPase signaling, filopodia induction

sources.title: Nuclear factor of activated T cells (NFATc4) is required for BDNF-dependent survival of adult-born neurons and spatial memory formation in the hippocampus
sources.key_contribution: NFATc4/calcineurin required for BDNF/TrkB-driven adult-born neuron survival
sources.used_for: AHN section; PLCγ-Ca²⁺-calcineurin-NFATc4 axis in neurogenesis

sources.title: Depletion of central BDNF in mice impedes terminal differentiation of new granule neurons in the adult hippocampus
sources.key_contribution: BDNF required for terminal differentiation (not proliferation) of new hippocampal neurons
sources.used_for: AHN section; BDNF as maturation factor

summary.note: Core mechanistic claims rely primarily on Minichiello 2002 (PMC6673845) and Musumeci 2009 (PMC2872928) partial full texts, plus Fenner 2012 (PMC4367905). Huang&Reichardt 2003, Minichiello 2009 reviews are abstracts only. All mechanisms described are consistent with established knowledge and cross-referenced with existing wiki content.
